decisive_spans.text: A punch biopsy showed no epidermal changes and revealed a dense inflammatory neutrophilic infiltrate within the dermis
a white-cell count of 13,000/mm3 with 89% neutrophils

response.rationale: Neutrophilic urticaria is strongly supported by the presence of a dense neutrophilic infiltrate in the dermis and elevated neutrophils in the blood. Other candidates are less supported or contradicted.
